competitors.name: Bagel Bites / Heinz
competitors.action: Bagel Bites is extending beyond its classic format with new Rolled Pizza Snacks in cheese and cheese-and-pepperoni varieties, already being spotted at Giant. It is a useful format signal: frozen pizza growth is still showing up in snackable, portable forms that can win younger or lunch-driven occasions without asking shoppers to commit to a full pie.

competitors.name: White Rabbit
competitors.action: White Rabbit secured a national ASDA listing for three gluten-free sourdough frozen SKUs across 522 stores from May 11 while Morrisons simultaneously expanded the brand with additional Italian meal-line items. The important signal for Real Dough is that freezer buyers are still rewarding sharply differentiated crust stories when the proposition is easy to read and priced accessibly.

competitors.name: Asda / Crosta Mollica
competitors.action: Asda is resetting the frozen aisle with 230-plus new frozen products and specifically calling out Crosta Mollica as a new brand in the refresh. That is a strong retail signal that large grocers still want more premium, Italian-coded frozen variety rather than simply defending legacy value lines.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza opportunity is widening across both format innovation and premium-retail assortment resets
trends.magnitude: Today’s clearest signals were Bagel Bites pushing snackable frozen pizza, White Rabbit scaling differentiated sourdough into national grocery, and Asda opening more frozen shelf space to premium Italian brands.
trends.context: For Real Dough, the read is pretty clean: the aisle is still making room for distinct propositions, but they need to communicate fast. The strongest lane remains a crisp sourdough quality story with obvious retail relevance rather than a vague premium claim.

breaking.headline: The freezer aisle still has room for new pizza stories, but the winners are increasingly the ones with instantly legible positioning.
breaking.impact: Snackable formats like Bagel Bites, sharply differentiated sourdough plays like White Rabbit, and retailer assortment resets like Asda’s all point the same direction: Real Dough should keep sharpening a one-line buyer story around authentic sourdough quality and why it deserves space versus both legacy brands and adjacent snack formats.
